notes.title: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster Joins Metroidvania Fusion Celebration
notes.notes:
In an exciting announcement, Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster will join the celebration of Metroidvania games at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41046058/sale/MetroidvaniaFusion]Metroidvania Fusion[/url] event. As part of this special collaboration, a demo of the game will be available during the event from March 4th to 11th. Fans will be able to immerse themselves in this unique adventure and discover the wonders that await them in the world of Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster.

notes.title: Barbarian Saga: to Make a Tokyo Game Show 2023 Steam event appearance
notes.notes:
In a thrilling development for fans of action-adventure games, Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster is set to make a special appearance at the Tokyo Game Show 2023. This exciting event will offer gamers a sneak peek into the mystical world of Barbarian Saga, showcasing elements of its unique gameplay and captivating storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599287/6b13b6c5c155e5936599d9372a18c664c8d3007b.png[/img]

In this epic adventure, players assume the role of the last Beastmaster, harnessing the souls of animals and creatures to transform and progress through the game. The title features a continuous Metroidvania-style map, enabling players to unlock new paths and routes using their Beastmaster abilities. The world is teeming with evil and sorcery, lurking around every corner.

A unique aspect of Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster is the collection of beads for the protagonist's ritual necklace. These beads can grant various enhancements, such as fangs, amulets, and plant roots that modify attacks, vitality, or mana.

The game also offers thrilling duels in different arenas, reminiscent of classic fighting games. With a close camera and energy bars, players can enhance their skills and acquire unique items by triumphing in these challenging battles.

Players can uncover new sword techniques taught by their Sensei, utilize magic potions, and cast curses. The protagonist's sword holds the potential to harness god-like powers, adding an exciting dimension to the gameplay.

Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster promises a rich and immersive world, and its presence at the Tokyo Game Show 2023 has generated significant anticipation among gamers worldwide. With the prospect of a gameplay reveal, fans can hardly contain their excitement for this upcoming title, poised to redefine the action-adventure genre.

Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster is set to make its mark at this prestigious event, promising an unforgettable experience for attendees and gamers following the event online.

Inspired by classic movies and games of the 80’s and 90’s such as Beastmaster, Conan and Deathstalker, Castlevania, Golden Axe and Ghouls ‘n’ Ghosts,[b] Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster[/b] has strived to craft a world brought to life with a deeply immersive story and is drawn and animated by hand using hundreds of sketches to bring the [u]world of Arborea to life. [/u]

[previewyoutube=yHlzDAX1mH0;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]After the brief peace that followed the wars of the portals that devastated the country, new winds of war now threaten its inhabitants. The new king of Imperia together with the Sacred Kingdom has declared war against non-humans, using the services of one of the Last Wizards of Arborea: Trece XIII and their generals. This is the moment of the prophecy, the moment when a chosen one will unite Men and beasts to bring peace. Welcome to the world of Arborea, welcome to Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster.
[/i]
[list]
[*]  You are the last of the Beastmasters, use the souls of animals and creatures to transform and progress through the adventure.
[*]  Explore a continuous Metroidvania-style map, open new paths and unlock new routes with your Beastmaster abilities. Evil and sorcery lurk in all corners.
[*]  Gather beads for your ritual necklace: discover fangs, amulets, and plant roots that will change your attacks, vitality, or Mana.
[*]  Enhance your skills and acquire new items by entering duels in different Arenas. battles will use close cameras and energy bars like in classic fighting games..
[*]  Find new sword techniques that your old Sensei taught you, use magic potions and summon curses. Thanks to your sword, you have the power of a god.
[*]  Throughout your adventure, you will discover NPCs that will give more depth to the narrative and communicating with them will open new mission arcs (as in an Anime series) and completely different endings.
[/list]

Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster will launch globally for Steam, Xbox Series, [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008741]PlayStation 5[/url] and Nintendo Switch
